title: Unsupervised Detection of Underground Tunnels in Ground-Penetrating Radar Using Depth-Restricted Reconstruction Scoring
abstract: arXiv:2607.04882v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Hand-dug tunnels that reach buried pipelines from below are hard to find before they are used, and too rare to train a supervised detector. The engineering application of this work is detecting such tunnels in ground-penetrating radar surveys of a monitored site. The contribution in artificial intelligence is a detection scheme that needs no tunnel examples: a convolutional autoencoder learns the site's normal ground from surveys recorded before any tunnel exists, later survey windows are scored by their largest reconstruction errors within the travel-time band where a tunnel can lie, and evaluation holds out whole survey lines. On field data from a tunnel hand-dug for this study (0.6 m wide, 1 m high, roof 0.9-1.4 m deep) and surveyed repeatedly with a 250-megahertz radar in dry and wet conditions, the detector reaches an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.994 and an F1 score of 0.972 on 1,600 test win

translated_title: 基于深度受限重建评分的探地雷达地下隧道无监督检测
translated_abstract: 从下方挖至埋地管道的手工隧道在被利用之前很难被发现，而且此类样本过于稀少，无法训练监督式检测器。本工作的工程应用是在受监测场地的探地雷达勘测中检测此类隧道。其在人工智能方面的贡献是一种无需隧道样本的检测方案：卷积自编码器从任何隧道存在之前记录的勘测数据中学习场地的正常地下状况，随后通过在隧道可能存在的走时频带内的最大重建误差对后续勘测窗口进行评分，并且评估时对整条勘测测线进行了留出。在本研究专门手工挖掘的隧道实地数据上（宽0.6米、高1米、顶板深度0.9-1.4米），使用250兆赫兹雷达在干燥和潮湿条件下反复勘测，该检测器在1600个测试窗口上达到了0.994的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）和0.972的F1分数。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需任何隧道样本的无监督检测方案，利用卷积自编码器学习场地正常地下状况，并通过深度受限的重建误差评分，在实地探地雷达数据中实现了近乎完美的地下隧道检测性能（AUC达0.994）。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an unsupervised tunnel detection scheme requiring no tunnel examples, using a convolutional autoencoder trained on normal ground surveys with depth-restricted reconstruction error scoring, achieving near-perfect performance (AUC 0.994) on field ground-penetrating radar data.
